dana_knows.text: The checkout error-rate alert fired at 2:04 a.m.
About a third of checkouts are failing, in the middle of the flash sale.
The team shipped a release, v2.14.0, at 1:47 a.m. I don't know what was in it.
There's also a high CPU warning on search-service.

help_ladder.fact: Error rate jumped from 0.4% to about 31% starting around 01:50, and orders per minute fell from 420 to about 290.
help_ladder.hint: Open the dashboard. When did the errors start, and how many customers are hit?

help_ladder.fact: The failing requests are guest checkouts (guest=true), all with KeyError: 'tier' in loyalty_percent.
help_ladder.hint: Open the logs. Is every customer failing, or only some of them?

help_ladder.fact: v2.14.0 shipped at 01:47 and changed checkout/pricing.py: loyalty_percent now reads customer.profile["tier"].
help_ladder.hint: Open the deploy history. What changed right before the errors started?

help_ladder.fact: The runbook says: stop the damage first. If a release broke checkout, roll back, then investigate.
help_ladder.hint: Check the runbook. What does it say to do first when a release breaks checkout?

help_ladder.fact: The team rolled back to v2.13.9. Errors are going back to normal. Loyalty discounts are OFF until a fix ships.
help_ladder.hint: Customers are still failing. Is there a safe way to undo tonight's change while you keep investigating?

help_ladder.fact: Guest customers have no loyalty tier, so the new code's customer.profile["tier"] raises KeyError.
help_ladder.hint: Compare the failing requests with the new code. What does the new code expect every customer to have?

help_ladder.fact: The fix is merged with passing CI and deployed.
help_ladder.hint: Write a failing test that shows the bug, then fix it in the pilot repo and open a PR.

all_found_hint: You've found everything. Write it down for the morning shift: impact, cause, action and risk.

answer_key.root_cause: v2.14.0 added loyalty-tier discounts. loyalty_percent reads customer.profile["tier"], guests have no tier, so checkout raises KeyError: 'tier' at checkout/pricing.py:19.
answer_key.fix: A missing or unknown tier gives a 0% loyalty discount. Tests must reject a lazy try/except that returns a $0 order total.
